name: DGP Prashant Kumar
role: Director General of Police (UP) — Indian domestic law enforcement liaison
real_life_inspiration: Prashant Kumar — real IPS officer and former UP DGP. Known for high-profile operations against organised crime in Uttar Pradesh.

inspiration_notes.real_prashant_kumar: A real IPS (Indian Police Service) officer who served as UP DGP. Unlike most characters in the film who are disguised, the film uses his actual name — consistent with Aditya Dhar's pattern of keeping real names for Pakistani adversaries AND for certain Indian law enforcement figures who are sympathetic to the hawkish narrative.
inspiration_notes.film_role: In Film 2, DGP Kumar represents the Indian domestic enforcement arm that coordinates with IB when the Khanani FICN network's India-side distribution chain is being dismantled. His role bridges the Karachi operation to the UP/Punjab domestic nexus.
inspiration_notes.punjab_khalistani_arc: The Punjab/Khalistan subplot in Film 2 connects the Happy PHD (Harmeet Singh) Khalistani network to the Karachi-ISI supply chain. DGP Kumar is the Indian law enforcement face of tackling this domestic end of the network.
